ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The graph plots percent survival versus hours post-infection with fungus. All groups begin near 100% survival at time 0. Over the 6-day period, the highest curve, labeled A, stays close to 100% survival, while the lower curves decline substantially, with C and D falling especially sharply. Reasoning: The experiment used mutant fruit flies infected with Neurospora crassa, and some flies were engineered to express drosomycin. The drosomycin-expressing mutant flies match the high-survival curve, showing much better survival than mutant infected flies without that protection. Therefore, drosomycin protected the flies from the fungal infection.
